verdict.rationale: Typesense is open source and self-hostable: it can run locally or on any server (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux packages, Terraform), so users fully control where their data physically lives. Typesense Cloud is offered as a dedicated-cluster alternative. Missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for Typesense Cloud clusters, explicit residency or compliance-by-region documentation, independent corroboration.
